prompt:
A research sample contains 0.350 mol of neon gas (Ne, molar mass 20.2 g mol^-1). Take N_A = 6.02 * 10^23 mol^-1.
(a) Calculate the number of neon atoms in the sample. [1]
(b) Calculate the mass of the sample in grams. [1]
hints: In (a), multiply moles by the Avogadro constant.
In (b), multiply moles by the molar mass.
teacher_walkthrough: Check basic execution of the two foundational relationships: N = n * N_A and m = n * M.
Ensure answers are stated to standard 3 significant figures.

provenance.abstract_pattern: paired one-step calculation from molar amount
